mapper.select: select count(*) = 2 from information_schema.tables where table_schema = current_schema() and table_name in ('byai_resource_favorite', 'byai_resource_favorite_count')
mapper.insert: insert into byai_resource_favorite_count (com_acct_id, resource_id, favorite_count) values (#{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, 0) on conflict (com_acct_id, resource_id) do nothing

insert into byai_resource_favorite (com_acct_id, user_id, resource_id, create_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{resourceId}, current_timestamp) on conflict (com_acct_id, user_id, resource_id) do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from byai_resource_favorite where com_acct_id = #{tenantId} and user_id = #{userId} and resource_id = #{resourceId}
